# ROvis.utils

## Rijksoverheid Visualisatie - utils

## Description

ROvis.utils is an R package that provides a comprehensive suite of
utilities for visualizing in Rijksoverheid style.

## Installation

Install the latest release from
[R-universe](https://rivm-syso.r-universe.dev):

``` r

install.packages(
  "ROvis.utils",
  repos = c("https://rivm-syso.r-universe.dev", "https://cloud.r-project.org")
)
```

Install the development version from GitHub:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("rivm-syso/ROvis.utils")
```

A version number ending in `.9000` is a development version.

## Usage

``` r

library(ROvis.utils)

# Get the hex code for a named RIVM color
ro_color("robijnrood")
#> [1] "#ca005d"

# Get the full categorical color palette
ro_color_categorical()
```

## Contributing

We welcome contributions! Before you start, **please read
[CONTRIBUTING.md](https://rivm-syso.github.io/ROvis.utils/dev/CONTRIBUTING.md)**.
It explains how to open an issue, our git etiquette (branches, commits,
pull requests and reviews) and our code standards. See
[CONTRIBUTORS.md](https://rivm-syso.github.io/ROvis.utils/dev/CONTRIBUTORS.md)
for the list of contributors.

## Instructions for developers

Below we describe the most important guidelines and practicalities for R
package development on this project.

### Requirements

We use the `testthat`, `lintr` and `roxygen2` package for development of
tests, code style checks and automatic documentation. We also use the
`devtools` and `usethis` package during development to adhere to
standards for R packages and make developing easier! Install them in
your Rstudio environment:

``` r

install.packages("testthat")
install.packages("lintr")
install.packages("roxygen2")
install.packages("quarto")
install.packages("pkgdown")
install.packages("devtools")
install.packages("usethis")
```

### Guidelines

Type
[`devtools::load_all()`](https://devtools.r-lib.org/reference/load_all.html)
in your console each time you start developing. This loads all
dependencies and non-exported functions in the NAMESPACE. This makes
developing a lot easier!

To ensure code standardization and quality, follow these guidelines: -
Add tests with
[`usethis::use_test()`](https://usethis.r-lib.org/reference/use_r.html) -
Add a new package dependency to the DESCRIPTION file with
[`usethis::use_package()`](https://usethis.r-lib.org/reference/use_package.html).
We use the `min_version` argument to specify a minimum version. - Add a
new function dependency to the NAMESPACE with
[`usethis::use_import_from()`](https://usethis.r-lib.org/reference/use_import_from.html) -
Add documentation to new functions by inserting a roxygen skeleton and
use
[`devtools::document()`](https://devtools.r-lib.org/reference/document.html)
to create automatic documentation in the `man` folder

# Package index

## All functions

- [`ro_check_if_font_available()`](https://rivm-syso.github.io/ROvis.utils/dev/reference/ro_check_if_font_available.md)
  : Check whether a font family is available on the system
- [`ro_color()`](https://rivm-syso.github.io/ROvis.utils/dev/reference/ro_color.md)
  : Return hex code of RIVM color
- [`ro_color_categorical()`](https://rivm-syso.github.io/ROvis.utils/dev/reference/ro_color_categorical.md)
  : Show hex codes of RIVM categorical color palette
- [`ro_color_palette()`](https://rivm-syso.github.io/ROvis.utils/dev/reference/ro_color_palette.md)
  : Return named list with hexcodes RIVM palette
- [`ro_color_seq()`](https://rivm-syso.github.io/ROvis.utils/dev/reference/ro_color_seq.md)
  : Return sequence of hex color codes between two diverging colors
- [`ro_color_seq_named()`](https://rivm-syso.github.io/ROvis.utils/dev/reference/ro_color_seq_named.md)
  : Set RIVM colors to specific levels to use in scale_color_manual for
  maps or other visualizations.
- [`ro_get_color_palette()`](https://rivm-syso.github.io/ROvis.utils/dev/reference/ro_get_color_palette.md)
  : Return named list with hexcodes RIVM palette
- [`ro_group_badge()`](https://rivm-syso.github.io/ROvis.utils/dev/reference/ro_group_badge.md)
  : Build backend group badge(s) for use in roxygen documentation
- [`ro_show_colors()`](https://rivm-syso.github.io/ROvis.utils/dev/reference/ro_show_colors.md)
  : Show RIVM color palette
